title: Al Ain, Abu Dhabi — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Al Ain, Abu Dhabi: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Al Ain is a city in Abu Dhabi with a population of 766,000. The Garden City of the Gulf, a lush inland oasis known for its university, heritage sites, and the majestic Jebel Hafeet mountain. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 11a growing zone supports Very hot — tropical fruits, multiple growing cycles. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 340 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
